content: AnySoftKeyboard uses Robolectric + Mockito + RxJava TestSchedulers in a base class (AnySoftKeyboardBaseTest) that manages the full ServiceController lifecycle. Tests run in src/androidTest with RobolectricTestRunner. This is the heavy approach — appropriate for testing the full IME service but overkill for pure composition logic. HeliBoard (fork of OpenBoard/AOSP) follows a similar pattern. Neither project extensively tests pure text-composition logic separately from the Android service; they test the whole service via Robolectric shadows.
